messages:
Alex Romero: quick sync post-launch: we have 2 customer-facing regressions, ~11 cosmetic bugs, and 4 enhancement asks from the pilot. propose a compact "burn+invest" rhythm: 4 days focused on fixes, then 2 days for one gated enhancement. thoughts?
Priya Desai: +1. keeping the invest window small helps avoid scope creep. recommend a strict gate for the enhancement: telemetry hooks + rollback plan + perf check.
Miles Carter: ops note: one regression seems tied to KV cache eviction policy under longer sequences. i can push a conservative bump to TTL and add telemetry in a single patch. needs a 2-hour canary.
Hannah Li: product perspective  rank everything by customer-impact and release-risk. small UX bugs that don't affect core flows should be low priority for the burn sprint. the pilot asks should be scored by churn-reduction potential.
Alex Romero: decision draft: Mon-Thu = bug burn (hotfix lane for any paying-customer regressions), Fri-Sat = single enhancement behind flag (if it meets gates). gates: no open p0s, smoke tests green, p99 <= baseline*1.10, and feature has telemetry + rollback.
Priya Desai: i'll own the gating checklist template and post it here. quick snippet: 1) acceptance metric, 2) telemetry events, 3) canary % and window, 4) rollback trigger thresholds.
Miles Carter: scheduling note: canary Wed 03:00-05:00 UTC works for infra. i'll prepare the TTL bump PR with test coverage and a canary runbook.
Hannah Li: owners: Miles -> KV fix + canary; Priya -> gating checklist + feature acceptance; Alex -> customer comms and sprint board. we'll do a 15-min sync tomorrow morning if anything blocks.
DeployBot: Canary window scheduled: 2026-03-25 03:00-05:00 UTC. Runbooks updated in #eng-oncall.
Alex Romero: action items summarized: Priya posts gating template by EOD; Miles lands TTL patch and canary runbook; Hannah updates backlog prioritization and marks two pilot asks as "invest-if-gated". keep updates short in-thread. thanks :thumbsup:
